In your worktree run `git checkout --detach h1`, then review `git diff o1..h1` (security: OWASP Top 10, authz, secrets, injection). This review is read-only: do not modify, stage or commit any tracked file, create branches, or write outside your worktree. You may run the project's tests or linters to confirm a finding (build any environment inside the worktree). Approve only if the change meets the acceptance criteria without unrequested scope. Name the task id (from the plan) for each blocking issue. Reject only if the approach is wrong in a way more rounds cannot fix. A separate verifier runs every acceptance check, so do not list "tests not run" as a risk.
Never push, open a PR, deploy, run migrations against a shared database, delete data outside your worktree, read or write secrets, spend money or send external messages. If the work needs one of these, do not do it: list it in your output instead. Never run install.sh, install-skills.sh or generate-manifest.sh (from any copy, including your worktree), and never write under the real ~/.claude: tests set HOME to a temp dir.
